Class 7A playoff preview: Zion-Benton and Mundelein in Opening Round
Zion-Benton and Mundelein play in Class 7A Opening Round games this weekend, and according to our projections, one game will be a blowout.
Zion-Benton and Mundelein play in Class 7A Opening Round games this weekend, and according to our projections, one game will be a blowout.
The top 16 seeds in the 48-team Class 7A field have byes in the Opening Round, and the other 32 teams play Friday and Saturday, Oct. 23-24.
Winners advance to the First Round on Saturday, Oct. 31.
We call a game competitive if our projection has it decided by 10 points or fewer and a blowout if the margin is 21 points or more.
Opening Round schedule and predictions
Friday, Oct. 23
- 6:30 p.m.: No. 42 Mundelein (3-6) at No. 23 Lincoln-Way West (5-4) (Lincoln-Way West 39, Mundelein 12)
- 7 p.m.: No. 44 Glenbrook North (3-6) at No. 21 Zion-Benton (6-3) (Zion-Benton 35, Glenbrook North 15)
Game Capsules
No. 44 Glenbrook North (3-6) at No. 21 Zion-Benton (6-3)
Glenbrook North travels to Zion-Benton in the Class 7A Opening Round, and the winner plays at No. 12 Rockford Guilford (7-2) in the First Round.
Kickoff is 7 p.m. Friday.
#21 Zion-Benton (6-3)
Zion-Benton (6-3) is the No. 21 seed in the 48-team Class 7A field and hosts No. 44 Glenbrook North in the Opening Round.
Zion-Benton went 6-3 overall and 4-3 in North Suburban, scoring 272 points and allowing 191, an average margin of +9.0 a game.
Zion-Benton went 4-5 and missed the playoffs last season. Zion-Benton has reached the playoffs in one of the last 10 seasons.
Location: Zion
Enrollment: 1,920
Playoff Appearances: 12 in 52 IHSA Playoff Seasons since 1974 (23 percent)
All-Time Playoff Record: 6-11
2025: 4-5, Missed Playoffs
Players to Watch:
- Jamere French (RB, 6-0, 195 lbs., Sr.): committed to Ohio; averages 188.3 rushing yards a game
- Josiah Funderberg (DL, Sr.): averages 5.1 tackles a game and has seven sacks
- Kevin James (WR, Sr.): averages 61.6 receiving yards a game
- Rashad Love (S, Sr.): has three interceptions
- Marquan Gordon (QB, Jr.): has thrown eight touchdown passes
Regular Season: 6-3 overall, 4-3 in North Suburban. PF 272, PA 191, average margin +9.0. Def. North Chicago (2-7) 61-12; Def. Rich Township (3-6) 47-20; Def. Lake Forest (2-7) 32-16; Def. Stevenson (4-5) 42-23; Lost to Lake Zurich (6-3) 24-7; Lost to Gurnee Warren (4-5) 49-6; Def. Waukegan (0-9) 48-0; Def. Mundelein (3-6) 21-12; Lost to Libertyville (7-2) 35-8.
Best Win: Def. Stevenson (4-5) 42-23 (Week 4)
Worst Loss: Lost to Gurnee Warren (4-5) 49-6 (Week 6)
#44 Glenbrook North (3-6)
Location: Northbrook
Enrollment: 2,144
Playoff Appearances: 18 in 52 IHSA Playoff Seasons since 1974 (35 percent)
All-Time Playoff Record: 11-16
State Titles: 1 (1974 in 5A)
2025: 2-7, Missed Playoffs
Players to Watch:
- Florians Naglins (OT, 6-7, 275 lbs., Jr.)
Regular Season: 3-6 overall, 1-2 in Central Suburban (Central). PF 182, PA 268, average margin -9.6. Def. Lakes (4-5) 15-6; Lost to Grant (7-2) 41-14; Lost to Highland Park (6-3) 42-7; Lost to Niles North (6-3) 55-36; Lost to Glenbrook South (5-4) 53-10; Lost to Evanston (5-4) 31-14; Def. Niles West (0-9) 41-14; Def. Maine East (0-9) 42-7; Lost to Deerfield (5-4) 19-3.
Best Win: Def. Lakes (4-5) 15-6 (Week 1)
Worst Loss: Lost to Glenbrook South (5-4) 53-10 (Week 5)
Prediction: Zion-Benton 35, Glenbrook North 15 (Zion-Benton has an 82% chance to win, according to our model).
No. 42 Mundelein (3-6) at No. 23 Lincoln-Way West (5-4)
Mundelein travels to Lincoln-Way West in the Class 7A Opening Round, and the winner plays at No. 10 Plainfield North (7-2) in the First Round.
Kickoff is 6:30 p.m. Friday.
#42 Mundelein (3-6)
Mundelein (3-6) is the No. 42 seed in the 48-team Class 7A field and visits No. 23 Lincoln-Way West in the Opening Round. It qualified with a losing record.
Mundelein went 3-6 overall and 1-6 in North Suburban, scoring 174 points and allowing 175, an average margin of -0.1 a game.
Mundelein went 2-7 and missed the playoffs last season. Mundelein has not reached the playoffs in the last 10 seasons.

Prediction: Lincoln-Way West 39, Mundelein 12 (Lincoln-Way West has an 89% chance to win, according to our model).
